title: Accepted nonterminal phases must retain a durable successor-dispatch obligation
description:
Source: owner message #4731; related wi_0c7ab8fc3320b52b@2/order4402 and Feature wi_618c8ff87e6b8061@5. This bounded intake is separate from the current 4402 candidate and does not widen it.

Required behavior: native acceptance of one nonterminal item/revision/candidate/phase creates exactly one durable lead successor-dispatch obligation. It remains until verified exact successor assignment plus acknowledgment/progress, or an explicitly owned dependency with resume condition. Cover accepted phase with no successor, unrelated lead activity, exact predecessor/candidate/acceptance-to-successor item/order/run linkage, independent sibling obligations, and replayed acceptance/disposition idempotence. No runtime-hang assumption, live fixtures, general semantic consumer, or lifecycle mutation.

Observations: root/Codex-authored #4722 reports the owner health question; lead-recovery #4725 records the causal account; correction #4732 distinguishes immediate packaging from recurrence prevention. Lead owns allocation; implementation/review only after this saved record receives a bounded order.


Durable continuation scope added from owner #5916 and audit sources #5871/#5879/#5885/#5889/#5892: implement authoritative phase visibility separate from Queue cycle lifecycle, with exact responsible member/action, observedAt and coverage; automatically flag/reconcile closed or superseded primaries without erasing item scope/history; prevent misleading executing counts and stale-primary alarms when QA/release owns a successor; keep unknown visibly unverified; and cover builder-result plus QA-active, accepted-source plus release-pending, closed-stale-primary, independent sibling, concurrent revision, and no-duplicate-enqueue regressions.
